cells.tense: Joy raised together is being shared right now, and you are handing it over whole.
cells.act: gather the scattered thoughts into one line
cells.ask: Before the next thing worth celebrating, sit quiet for a minute and gather what it means to you into a single line.
cells.core:
The things you celebrate with people carry a meaning that can be felt. You can raise that meaning without losing the point of it — find the detail that makes an evening land, and it lands for the people there, not only for you. Joy spreads because you stayed in the present instead of aiming at how the retelling would go.

What this balance is free to feed next is your own alignment: a quieter sitting with what a joy means before it is passed on. Before the next thing worth celebrating, sit quiet for a minute and gather what it means to you into a single line. The line can be for you alone. The celebration after it carries more, and nothing about it gets heavier to hold.
cells.sheetLine: You can raise a table into joy and still keep one clear point.
cells.verb: raising joy in shared meaning and letting it pass among people
cells.place: where you know what to attend to before you can say why

cells.tense: Each gathering is being loaded with what it must mean before anyone arrives.
cells.act: commit to the long build and do today's part
cells.ask: Pick one shared thing worth keeping alive and do today's small piece of it — one call, one note, twenty minutes.
cells.core:
Where joy gets raised among people, you are working three moves out — planning what each gathering has to accomplish, setting the tone before anyone shows, carrying whether it lands. What was warmth has become a build, and the people in it can feel the scaffolding around the fun. Knowing what to attend to has turned into knowing what everything must become, and the moment happening now keeps getting skipped.

Long keeping is the way back. Pick one shared thing worth keeping alive and do today's small piece of it — one call, one note, twenty minutes. That is all. Insight comes from persisting at one thing over time, not from another plan about the next one. What falls away when you stop the building will be the parts that needed to fall anyway.
cells.sheetLine: You are producing joy rather than being in it with them.
cells.verb: raising joy in shared meaning and letting it pass among people
cells.place: where you know what to attend to before you can say why

cells.tense: The shared joy already ended, and the calendar still holds its slot as if it were happening.
cells.act: follow the thought past where it is comfortable
cells.ask: Take one celebration you no longer join and follow what it was really about until you reach the edge of your understanding, then stay there.
cells.core:
Some shared joy has already ended, and the slot for it is still on your calendar. You keep showing up for the gathering, or you keep the date clear in case it returns, and the thing has stopped being alive for you. Knowing what to attend to is running on old signals. The hours go to maintaining a shape rather than to seeing what actually matters now.

The charge comes sideways here, through thinking. Take one celebration you no longer join and follow what it was really about until you reach the edge of your understanding, then stay there. That is not busywork. It is how a starved capacity gets fed by something a real current can run on, and it tells you what was worth carrying and what was only habit.

cells.tense: You are already choosing what the group's joy will mean, and your account has it happening on its own.
cells.act: bring the two sides of your thinking into one plan
cells.ask: Name one shared joy you have been steering quietly — a tone, an invitation list, what gets honored — and bring what you know and feel about it into one plan.
cells.core:
Somewhere in the shared things you are part of, the joy's meaning is being set by your hand. You decide what the group celebrates, what gets left out of the story, what the tradition now stands for. Asked, you would say it just happens that way. It does not. The transmission under the celebration is running, and the one running it is not signing.

Bring it down to the earlier form. Name one shared joy you have been steering quietly — a tone, an invitation list, what gets honored — and bring what you know and feel about it into one plan. That is all. The shape you have been keeping quiet about becomes a shape people can answer, which is a different thing from something they are supposed to feel.
cells.sheetLine: The group's joy is carrying your edit, and you would say it just happened.
cells.verb: raising joy in shared meaning and letting it pass among people
cells.place: where you know what to attend to before you can say why
